shots.base: DeepSeek sits behind her drum kit facing the camera, both sticks raised high above her head a split second before a big hit, eyes fierce and excited. Setting: a floating stage high above a sea of clouds at dusk. The round stage is pale stone with brass inlays and a softly glowing rim; behind it the orange sun sits low over rolling clouds and the sky fades from amber to violet with a few early stars; distant floating islands trail small waterfalls; paper lanterns hang from thin brass poles along the stage edge; two tall brass lighting towers throw warm spotlights.

poses.edit: Both sticks come down together, hitting the snare and the floor tom at the same moment; her hair bounces up from the impact.
Her right stick strikes the crash cymbal and her body leans forward into the hit.

shots.base: Gemini plays her bass, slung high so both hands are in frame; her fingers rest on the strings and she looks down at the bass. Setting: a floating stage high above a sea of clouds at dusk. The round stage is pale stone with brass inlays and a softly glowing rim; behind it the orange sun sits low over rolling clouds and the sky fades from amber to violet with a few early stars; distant floating islands trail small waterfalls; paper lanterns hang from thin brass poles along the stage edge; two tall brass lighting towers throw warm spotlights.

poses.edit: Her thumb slaps a string and her head nods down with the beat.
Her index finger plucks a string and she smiles at the camera.
